tools.name: list_tracked_laws
tools.title: List laws in the BotNotice library
tools.description: Lists laws in the BotNotice library that match the filters given.

place.description: A code (CA, NY, US-FED, EU, UK) or a name.

use.description: A kind of AI use the law's summary lists.

in_force_on.description: A date, YYYY-MM-DD: only laws in force on that date.

tools.name: laws_for_business
tools.title: Laws in the library matching a business's uses and places
tools.description: Lists laws in the BotNotice library whose summaries name the uses and places given, with what each says and its sources. General information about laws BotNotice tracks. Not a determination that any law applies to anyone.

use_cases.description: How the business uses AI. Codes: support_chatbot (Customer-service / FAQ chatbot); sales_chatbot (Sales, lead-capture, or booking chatbot); companion_chatbot (Chatbot with memory, persona, or relationship features); voice_agent (AI phone / voice agent); ai_content (AI-generated marketing text, images, or video); synthetic_performers (AI-generated 'people' in ads); ai_hiring (AI in hiring, screening, or HR decisions); healthcare (AI in patient diagnosis, treatment, or care); mental_health (AI offering emotional support or therapy-like help); advice (AI giving financial, legal, or medical guidance); automated_decisions (AI deciding eligibility (credit, housing, insurance, benefits)). Default: support_chatbot.

states.description: Two-letter U.S. state codes where the customers are, e.g. ["CA","NY"]. Leave out with all_us.

all_us.description: Customers anywhere in the U.S. The default when no place is given.

eu.description: People in the European Union can use the AI.

uk.description: People in the United Kingdom can use the AI.

minors.description: Whether minors may use it: no, possible (default), or directed (aimed at them).

memory.description: The bot remembers people or builds rapport (companion-style).

licensed_profession.description: A state-licensed profession: health, legal, accounting.

big_platform.description: 10 million or more unique monthly U.S. visitors.

tools.name: get_law
tools.title: One AI disclosure law in full
tools.description: The full record for one law: who must comply, what to disclose, timing, duties, exemptions, penalties, enforcement, sources and the last-verified date. Slugs come from list_laws or the dataset at https://botnotice.app/datasets/ai-disclosure-laws.json.

slug.description: The law's slug, e.g. california-sb-243 or eu-ai-act-article-50.

tools.name: list_laws
tools.title: List the tracked AI disclosure laws
tools.description: Every AI disclosure law BotNotice tracks (U.S. states, federal, EU, UK), with status and effective date, optionally filtered. Also the pending bills.

jurisdiction.description: A code (CA, NY, US-FED, EU, UK) or a name.

applies_to.description: Only laws whose summary lists this kind of AI use.

tools.name: check_website
tools.title: Check a website for AI chat tools and an AI notice
tools.description: Reads a public website: which chat or voice-AI tools it runs and whether an AI disclosure is shown in the page source. It does not say which laws apply. Not legal advice.

Codes: support_chatbot (Customer-service / FAQ chatbot); sales_chatbot (Sales, lead-capture, or booking chatbot); companion_chatbot (Chatbot with memory, persona, or relationship features); voice_agent (AI phone / voice agent); ai_content (AI-generated marketing text, images, or video); synthetic_performers (AI-generated 'people' in ads); ai_hiring (AI in hiring, screening, or HR decisions); healthcare (AI in patient diagnosis, treatment, or care); mental_health (AI offering emotional support or therapy-like help); advice (AI giving financial, legal, or medical guidance); automated_decisions (AI deciding eligibility (credit, housing, insurance, benefits)).
